name: Network Service Discovery
dense_text: Technique: T1046 Network Service Discovery. Behavioral indicators: internal or lateral host and service enumeration after access; port and service probes across systems inside the victim environment. Distinguishing conditions: the signature explicitly identifies internal or post-compromise service discovery a sweep is lateral or explicitly internal Representative procedures: As part of load balancing FRP can set healthCheck.type = "tcp" or healthCheck.type = "http" to check service status on specific hosts with TCPing or an HTTP request. InvisiMole can scan the network for open ports and vulnerable instances of RDP and SMB protocols. Lucifer can scan for open ports including TCP ports 135 and 1433. Xbash can perform port scanning of TCP and UDP ports. Rocke conducted scanning for exposed TCP port 7001 as well as SSH and Redis servers. Medusa Group has also utilized the publicly available scanning tool SoftPerfect Network Scanner (netscan.exe) to discover device hostnames and network services. the adversaries utilized Ping, the Advanced Port Scanner and Advanced IP Scanner to enumerate network devices. [Remsec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0125) has a plugin that can perform ARP scanning as well as port scanning.(Citation: Kaspersky ProjectSauron Technical Analysis)

name: Web Protocols
dense_text: Technique: T1071.001 Web Protocols. Behavioral indicators: command-and-control communication uses HTTP, HTTPS, or another web protocol; outbound web traffic or a web beacon is identified as C2 rather than ordinary browsing. Distinguishing conditions: HTTP or TLS application semantics are present and C2 intent is explicit Representative procedures: NETEAGLE will also use HTTP to download resources that contain an IP address and Port Number pair to connect to for further C2. Kazuar uses HTTP and HTTPS to communicate with the C2 server. BADHATCH can use HTTP and HTTPS over port 443 to communicate with actor-controlled C2 servers. BeaverTail has used HTTP GET request to download malicious payloads to include InvisibleFerret and HTTP POST to exfiltrate data to C2 infrastructure. [Bazar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0534) can use HTTP and HTTPS over ports 80 and 443 in C2 communications.(Citation: Cybereason Bazar July 2020)(Citation: NCC Group Team9 June 2020)(Citation: DFIR Conti Bazar Nov 2021) Cookies also contain hardcoded variables tutma or tutmc in the payload's HTTPS request. name: Valid Accounts
dense_text: Technique: T1078 Valid Accounts. Behavioral indicators: successful authentication using credentials accepted by the target service; a valid-account or successful-session signature rather than repeated guessing. Distinguishing conditions: credentials are accepted and access succeeds Representative procedures: APT28: The group has also leveraged default manufacturer's passwords to gain initial access to corporate networks via IoT devices such as a VOIP phone, printer, and video decoder. Linux Rabbit software acquires valid SSH accounts through brute force. Industroyer can use supplied user credentials to execute processes and stop services. the adversary used harvested credentials to authenticate against internal APIs, database systems, container registries, and logging infrastructure across targeted networks. AppleJeus has gained access to the 3CX corporate environment through legitimate VPN credentials. name: Non-Application Layer Protocol
dense_text: Technique: T1095 Non-Application Layer Protocol. Behavioral indicators: command-and-control communication uses raw TCP, UDP, ICMP, or another lower-layer channel; the sensor identifies socket-based C2 without a recognized application protocol. Distinguishing conditions: application protocol is unknown and raw/lower-layer C2 is explicit Representative procedures: Also, after retrieving a C2 IP address and Port Number, NETEAGLE will initiate a TCP connection to this socket. InvisibleFerret has also created a TCP reverse shell communicating via a socket connection over ports 1245, 80, 2245, 3001, and 5000. SystemBC has used raw TCP on non-standard ports, such as 4044, for C2 communications and for HTTP communications, which include downloading binaries. metaMain can establish an indirect and raw TCP socket-based connection to the C2 server. WarzoneRAT can communicate with its C2 server via TCP over port 5200. StarProxy contained code to support both UDP and TCP connections. [PingPull](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1031) variants have the ability to communicate with C2 servers using ICMP or TCP.(Citation: Unit 42 PingPull Jun 2022) [SombRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0615) has the ability to use TCP sockets to send data and ICMP to ping the C2 server.(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)(Citation: FireEye FiveHands April 2021)

name: Brute Force
dense_text: Technique: T1110 Brute Force. Behavioral indicators: repeated or systematic credential attempts against an authentication service; authentication failures or signatures that summarize multiple login attempts. Distinguishing conditions: the alert proves repeated credential attempts but not one-account/many-password distribution the account/password distribution is unknown authentication attempts fail or repetition is explicit credentials are attempted Representative procedures: FIN5 has has used the tool GET2 Penetrator to look for remote login and hard-coded credentials. Chaos conducts brute force attacks against SSH services to gain initial access. Kinsing software has attempted to brute force hosts over SSH. Pysa has used brute force attempts against a central management console, as well as some Active Directory accounts. Sandworm Team used a script to attempt RPC authentication against a number of hosts. [CrackMapExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0488) can brute force supplied user credentials across a network range.(Citation: CME Github September 2018) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has used brute force techniques to attempt account access when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are unavailable.(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020) [Caterpillar WebShell](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0572) has a module to perform brute force attacks on a system.(Citation: ClearSky Lebanese Cedar Jan 2021)

name: Password Spraying
dense_text: Technique: T1110.003 Password Spraying. Behavioral indicators: one or a small password set attempted across many accounts; low-and-slow authentication failures distributed across usernames. Distinguishing conditions: multi-account/small-password-set context is explicit one password is distributed across many accounts Representative procedures: Quad7 Activity has conducted a throttled variant of password spraying techniques that only utilized a single attempt to sign in within a 24-hour time period, eluding brute force detection thresholds. Bad Rabbit’s infpub.dat file uses NTLM login credentials to brute force Windows machines. CrackMapExec can brute force credential authentication by using a supplied list of usernames and a single password. [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has used a brute-force/password-spray tooling that operated in two modes: in password-spraying mode it conducted approximately four authentication attempts per hour per targeted account over the course of several days or weeks.(Citation: Microsoft STRONTIUM New Patterns Cred Harvesting Sept 2020)(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020) [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has also used a Kubernetes cluster to conduct distributed, large-scale password spray attacks.(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021) Linux Rabbit brute forces SSH passwords in order to attempt to gain access and install its malware onto the server. Distinguishing conditions: multi-account/small-password-set context is explicit one password is distributed across many accounts Representative procedures: Quad7 Activity has conducted a throttled variant of password spraying techniques that only utilized a single attempt to sign in within a 24-hour time period, eluding brute force detection thresholds. Bad Rabbit’s infpub.dat file uses NTLM login credentials to brute force Windows machines. CrackMapExec can brute force credential authentication by using a supplied list of usernames and a single password. [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has used a brute-force/password-spray tooling that operated in two modes: in password-spraying mode it conducted approximately four authentication attempts per hour per targeted account over the course of several days or weeks.(Citation: Microsoft STRONTIUM New Patterns Cred Harvesting Sept 2020)(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020) [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has also used a Kubernetes cluster to conduct distributed, large-scale password spray attacks.(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021) Linux Rabbit brute forces SSH passwords in order to attempt to gain access and install its malware onto the server. [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) has conducted brute force password spray attacks.(Citation: MSRC Nobelium June 2021)(Citation: MSTIC Nobelium Oct 2021)(Citation: NCSC et al APT29 2024) [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware attempts to connect to Windows shares for lateral movement by using a generated list of usernames, which center around permutations of the username Administrator, and weak passwords.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster RATs) [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has gained initial access through password spray attacks.(Citation: Microsoft Silk Typhoon MAR 2025)

name: Drive-by Compromise
dense_text: Technique: T1189 Drive-by Compromise. Behavioral indicators: malicious web content or exploit delivery flows from a site toward a client; a drive-by, exploit-kit, or malicious-script signature targets the visiting endpoint. Distinguishing conditions: malicious content is delivered to the client Representative procedures: UNC3890 actors established a watering hole on a legitimate shipping company login page to target website visitors. the threat actors used a watering hole attack on a popular software reseller to exploit the then-zero-day Internet Explorer vulnerability CVE-2014-0322. AppleJeus compromised the www.tradingtechnologies[.]com website hosting a hidden IFRAME to exploit visitors, two months before the site was known to deliver a compromised version of the X_TRADER software package. Darkhotel used embedded iframes on hotel login portals to redirect selected victims to download malware. RTM has distributed its malware via the RIG and SUNDOWN exploit kits, as well as online advertising network Yandex.Direct . APT28 has compromised targets via strategic web compromise utilizing custom exploit kits. [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496) has infected victim machines through compromised websites and exploit kits.(Citation: Secureworks REvil September 2019)(Citation: McAfee Sodinokibi October 2019)(Citation: Picus Sodinokibi January 2020)(Citation: Secureworks GandCrab and REvil September 2019) [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035) has compromised targets via strategic web compromise (SWC) utilizing a custom exploit kit.(Citation: Secureworks IRON LIBERTY July 2019)(Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A)(Citation: Gigamon Berserk Bear October 2021)

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
dense_text: Technique: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application. Behavioral indicators: an inbound request attempts to trigger a vulnerability in an exposed application; HTTP path or query carries exploit-oriented input such as injection, traversal, deserialization, or RCE payloads. Distinguishing conditions: event.action is exploit and the signature describes triggering a weakness the target is a public-facing application and traffic is inbound the malicious request is sent to the victim server the alert observes initial exploitation input exploits a server-side application Representative procedures: threat actors exploited CVE-2023-46805 and CVE-2024-21887 in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN appliances to enable authentication bypass and command injection. BlackTech has exploited a buffer overflow vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) 6.0, CVE-2017-7269, in order to establish a new HTTP or command and control (C2) server. threat actors exploited authentication bypass and remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-49706 and CVE-2025-49704) against on-premises SharePoint servers. APT41 exploited CVE-2021-26855 against a vulnerable Microsoft Exchange Server to gain initial access to the victim network. BOLDMOVE software is associated with exploitation of CVE-2022-49475 in FortiOS. ZxShell has been dropped through exploitation of CVE-2011-2462, CVE-2013-3163, and CVE-2014-0322. Ember Bear gains initial access to victim environments by exploiting external-facing services. [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has exploited known vulnerabilities such as CVE-2017-1000486 (Primefaces Application Expression Language Injection), CVE-2015-7450 (WebSphere Application Server SOAP Deserialization Exploit), CVE-2010-5326 (SAP NewWeaver Invoker Servlet Exploit), and EDB-ID-24963 (SAP NetWeaver ConfigServlet Remote Code Execution) to gain initial access.(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)

name: Exploitation of Remote Services
dense_text: Technique: T1210 Exploitation of Remote Services. Behavioral indicators: exploit traffic moves laterally from one internal system to another; an internal remote service such as SMB, RDP, or SSH is targeted for exploitation. Distinguishing conditions: the exploit is lateral and targets an internal remote service Representative procedures: Earth Lusca has used Mimikatz to exploit a domain controller via the ZeroLogon exploit (CVE-2020-1472). Emotet has been seen exploiting SMB via a vulnerability exploit like EternalBlue (MS17-010) to achieve lateral movement and propagation. Conficker exploited the MS08-067 Windows vulnerability for remote code execution through a crafted RPC request. InvisiMole can spread within a network via the BlueKeep (CVE-2019-0708) and EternalBlue (CVE-2017-0144) vulnerabilities in RDP and SMB respectively. Flame can use MS10-061 to exploit a print spooler vulnerability in a remote system with a shared printer in order to move laterally. [Lucifer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0532) can exploit multiple vulnerabilities including EternalBlue (CVE-2017-0144) and EternalRomance (CVE-2017-0144).(Citation: Unit 42 Lucifer June 2020) [WannaCry](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0366) uses an exploit in SMBv1 to spread itself to other remote systems on a network.(Citation: LogRhythm WannaCry)(Citation: FireEye WannaCry 2017)(Citation: US-CERT WannaCry 2017) Wizard Spider has exploited or attempted to exploit Zerologon (CVE-2020-1472) and EternalBlue (MS17-010) vulnerabilities.

name: Web Shell

name: Vulnerability Scanning

During [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058), threat actors scanned for SharePoint servers vulnerable to CVE-2025-53770.(Citation: Palo Alto SharePoint Vulnerabilities JUL 2025) During the [Anthropic AI-orchestrated Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0062), the adversary used Claude Code to scan target infrastructure to identify potential vulnerabilities and to enumerate services and endpoints.(Citation: Anthropic AI Orchestrated Campaign NOV 2025) [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) has conducted widespread scanning of target environments to identify vulnerabilities for exploit.(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021) [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) has used publicly accessible DNS logging services to identify servers vulnerable to Log4j (CVE 2021-44228).(Citation: CrowdStrike AQUATIC PANDA December 2021)

name: Content Injection
dense_text: Technique: T1659 Content Injection. Behavioral indicators: content in a network response or communication channel is inserted, replaced, or modified in transit; a sensor signature identifies injected response content delivered toward a recipient. Distinguishing conditions: a response or communication channel is explicitly modified in transit Representative procedures: Disco has achieved initial access and execution through content injection into DNS, HTTP, and SMB replies to targeted hosts that redirect them to download malicious files. MoustachedBouncer has injected content into DNS, HTTP, and SMB replies to redirect specifically-targeted victims to a fake Windows Update page to download malware.
